newsitem.title: USA: Cantel lowers FY 97 earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Cantel lowers FY 97 earnings forecast.

text.p: Cantel Industries Inc said Thursday that it is predicting sales of $34 million and revising its estimate of earnings downwards to between $0.23 and $0.27 per share for fiscal 1997, ending July 31.
In January the company had forecast earnings of between $0.40 and $0.50 per share.

The company said that lower than expected sales volume in the third quarter was due to delays in funding in certain Canadian medical and scientific markets and a more gradual buildup of the global distribution network of recently-acquired MediVators Inc.
The company said it has addressed the MediVators distribution issue, continue to take corrective action, and expect significant improvement during fiscal 1998.

In the third quarter, ended April 30, the company reported net sales of $7.9 million, and net income of $164,000 or $0.04 per share. In the year earlier period it reported net sales of $7.5 million and a net loss of $71,000 or $0.02 per share.
